support.title: Farmer Support & Schemes
support.description: Stay updated with the latest government initiatives and financial support systems designed to empower Indian agriculture in 2025.

pm_kisan.title: PM-KISAN (Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi)
pm_kisan.objective: To provide direct income support to small and marginal farmers.
pm_kisan.benefits: ₹6,000 per year in three installments directly to bank accounts.

pmfby.title: PMFBY (Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana)
pmfby.objective: Financial support and crop insurance against natural calamities.
pmfby.benefits: Low premiums (1.5% - 5%) covering yield loss and post-harvest damage.

kcc.title: Kisan Credit Card (KCC)
kcc.objective: To provide adequate and timely credit support from the banking system.
kcc.benefits: Loans up to ₹3 lakh at 7% interest with flexible repayment.

pmksy.title: PM Krishi Sinchai Yojana (PMKSY)
pmksy.objective: To enhance physical access of water on the farm and expand cultivable area.
pmksy.benefits: Subsidies for drip and sprinkler irrigation (More Crop Per Drop).

enam.title: e-NAM (National Agriculture Market)
enam.objective: Online trading platform for agricultural commodities in India.
enam.benefits: Transparency in pricing and reduced dependence on middlemen.

soil_health.title: Soil Health Card Scheme
soil_health.objective: To promote balanced use of fertilizers based on soil fertility.
soil_health.benefits: Detailed soil reports and crop-specific fertilizer recommendations.

rkvy.title: RKVY-RAFTAAR
rkvy.objective: Holistic development of agriculture and allied sectors.
rkvy.benefits: Support for agri-business startups and infrastructure grants.

aif.title: Agriculture Infrastructure Fund (AIF)
aif.objective: Post-harvest management infrastructure and community farming assets.
aif.benefits: Credit guarantee and interest subvention for cold storage and warehouses.

pkvy.title: Paramparagat Krishi Vikas Yojana (PKVY)
pkvy.objective: To promote organic farming and improve soil health.
pkvy.benefits: Financial aid for organic practices and certification support.

pmmsy.title: Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY)
pmmsy.objective: Development of the fisheries sector and aquaculture.
pmmsy.benefits: Subsidies for hatcheries, cold chains, and transport facilities.
